## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [ ] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)). I cannot set labels on this repository; suggested: `orig-external`, `cat-cleanup`, `area:test`, `mod-frost`.

## Affected area

Tests

## Summary

Two MoE test entries under `test/python/gemm/frost` import each other inside test functions:

- `test_moe_grouped_matmul_fwd.py` imports `_build_graph` from `test_moe_grouped_block_scale_matmul_fwd.py` in five places.
- `test_moe_grouped_block_scale_matmul_fwd.py` imports `_run_moe_swap_ab_quant` / `_run_moe_swap_ab_reductions` from `test_moe_grouped_matmul_fwd.py` in four.

`_COMBOS` and `_build_graph` move unchanged into a new `moe_block_scale_test_utils.py`, which imports only `cudnn` and `gemm_test_utils`. The block-scale entry imports both back under the same names, so its tests and the callers on open branches keep working. `test_moe_grouped_matmul_fwd.py` and `test_moe_combine_bulk.py` import the builder from the helper. The block-scale entry still imports the swap-AB runners, which leaves a one-way import between the two entries.

No product code changes.

## Why

CodeQL reported the cycle as a cyclic import on #1898 (https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/pull/1898#discussion_r4386985889), because that PR edited a test next to one of the five imports. Both directions date from #1090. The imports run inside test functions, so they cause no import-order failure today. This follows the same layout as the shared SM107 SDPA helpers in `sm107_half_test_utils.py`.

## Related issues

Follow-up to #1898.

## API and compatibility impact

None. Test only. Node IDs are unchanged.

## Testing

`_COMBOS` and `_build_graph` in the helper are byte-identical to their develop definitions (compared with `ast.get_source_segment`). `moe_block_scale_test_utils.py` imports no test module.

CPU only (no GPU visible), extension built from develop `c4fc9d99`, `CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES=1`, run from `test/python`. `--noconftest` is needed because the root conftest requires a CUDA device:

| Command | develop `c4fc9d99` | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| `python -m pytest --noconftest --collect-only -q gemm/frost/test_moe_grouped_block_scale_matmul_fwd.py gemm/frost/test_moe_grouped_matmul_fwd.py gemm/frost/test_moe_combine_bulk.py` | 908 collected | 908 collected, same node IDs |
| `python -m pytest --noconftest gemm/frost/test_moe_grouped_block_scale_matmul_fwd.py -k "lowers_internal_operation or analyzer or build_graph_keeps or one_sided_moe_dequant_does_not or preserves_block_scale_tile_constraints"` | 17 passed | 17 passed |
| `python -m pytest --noconftest gemm/frost/test_moe_grouped_matmul_fwd.py -k "norm2_is_refused or token_quant_requires_aligned_groups or templates_follow_internal_operation"` | 8 passed, 2 skipped | 8 passed, 2 skipped |

Per-test outcomes are identical on both trees. The two skips are `test_moe_templates_follow_internal_operation`, which needs a Blackwell-family GPU. Not run on a GPU.

@@ -0,0 +1,149 @@
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""The MoE grouped block-scale matmul graph builder, shared by the MoE test entries and independent of them."""
+
+import cudnn
+
+from gemm_test_utils import ceil_div as _ceil_div
+
+# combo -> (block_size, data dtype, SF dtype).
+_COMBOS = {
+    "nvfp4": (16, cudnn.data_type.FP4_E2M1, cudnn.data_type.FP8_E4M3),
+    "mxfp4": (32, cudnn.data_type.FP4_E2M1, cudnn.data_type.FP8_E8M0),
+    "mxfp8": (32, cudnn.data_type.FP8_E4M3, cudnn.data_type.FP8_E8M0),
+}
+
+
+def _build_graph(
+    E,
+    S,
+    N,
+    K,
+    num_groups,
+    combo="nvfp4",
+    offset_dt=cudnn.data_type.INT32,
+    quant=False,
+    output_dt=cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16,
+    reduction_mode=None,
+    reduction_dims=None,
+    reduction_stride=None,
+    reduction_dt=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT,
+    reduction_compute_dt=None,
+    quant_out_dt=cudnn.data_type.FP8_E4M3,
+    quant_scale_dt=cudnn.data_type.FP8_E8M0,
+    quant_scale_reorder=False,
+    quant_scale_dim=None,
+    quant_block_size=32,
+    quant_axis=None,
+    quant_group_offset=False,
+    weight_major="k",
+    a_dt_override=None,
+    b_dt_override=None,
+    dequant_a=True,
+    dequant_b=True,
+    epilogue_relu=False,
+    output_major="n",
+    offset_multiple=1,
+    scatter_top_k=None,
+    combine_top_k=None,
+    gather_rows=None,
+    scale_k=None,
+    negative_scale=(False, False),
+):
+    block_size, default_dt, sf_dt = _COMBOS[combo]
+    a_dt = default_dt if a_dt_override is None else a_dt_override
+    b_dt = default_dt if b_dt_override is None else b_dt_override
+    sf_k = K // block_size if scale_k is None else scale_k
+    g = cudnn.pygraph(
+        io_data_type=cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16,
+        intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT,
